claim: *Task-driven traversal.* A task enters the modeling substrate through a named system entity and follows only the represented relationships required by its engineering question.

topology.description: Directed task entry to named entity; equal unordered relation peers accessible selectively.

required_terms: Named entity A job or a service
Retrieve only the relations needed for the current question; no prescribed traversal order.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: A task enters through a named system entity. Connections fan out to six peer relationships: service registry, flow model, lifecycle, policy, provenance and measurements. The task retrieves only relationships needed for its question. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
